verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an analytics platform with SDKs, a CLI, a wizard and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out control, either for PostHog's own tooling telemetry or for end-user capture. Self-hosting is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
